info.title: parley — pub/sub topics for AI coding agents
info.description: Pub/sub topics for AI coding agents — lets Claude Code sessions message each other, with push delivery via Claude Code channels.

commands.name: devices
commands.description: List the devices this hub is shared with

commands.name: add
commands.description: Pair another device (prints a join command with a one-time code)

commands.name: install
commands.description: Run the hub as a background service and register Parley with Claude Code / Codex

commands.name: join
commands.description: Use another machine's hub from this device

commands.name: leave
commands.description: Stop using the joined hub (back to a hub on this machine)

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: MCP server over stdio — what an AI client launches; starts a hub if none runs

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the hub, connected sessions and topics

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove the service and those registrations (keeps your conversations)

commands.name: update
commands.description: Install the newest release (or just check for one)
